craft_notes: Sthāyin: wherever-verse (the permission). Sanskrit: īdṛśena krameṇaiva yatra kutrāpi cintanā...svayaṃ līnā varapradā → L4 keeps wherever + four sites. Rows: row 2 (sites uncut list). Close: boon-giving (the reward adjective). Rejected: 'anything goes' — killed: such-course kept (īdṛśena — METHOD, not license); dropping 'self dissolved' — killed: svayaṃ līnā is the mechanism.

lines: By just such course — wherever thought: void, wall,
l4.sanskrit_cite: īdṛśena krameṇaiva yatra kutrāpi cintanā | śūnye kuḍye pare pātre svayaṃ līnā varapradā

reads_against.argmap: Where can thought dissolve? → Thought dissolves in void, wall, supreme, vessel — self-dissolving gives boons.
c1_essence: Wherever thought: void, wall, supreme, vessel — self dissolved boons.
reads_against.c1_rasa: śānta with vīra (stillness with piercing resolve)
